one_line: Mughal emperor leading the long Deccan campaigns in his final decades.

appearance.age_look: Late 60s to early 70s, lean and wiry, with the posture of an aging but still disciplined commander.
appearance.face: Narrow, angular face with high cheekbones, sharp nose, and a neatly trimmed long beard tapering to a point; wheatish complexion lightly weathered by age and campaigning; keen, observant eyes with slightly arched brows; default expression calm, austere and controlled, with a hint of stern focus.
appearance.hair: Hair mostly hidden beneath a tall, slightly conical Mughal turban (kulah) wrapped in soft off‑white muslin with a thin gold edging, the front adorned with a single modest emerald-and-gold sarpech plume; visible sideburns and beard hair are steel‑grey with a few darker streaks.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, calf‑length Mughal jama cut cross‑over style and tied to the right, made of fine cream‑white cotton with very subtle pale‑gold vertical stripes and a thin maroon piping along the edges; over this is a sleeveless, hip‑length quilted velvet coat (nimqaba) in deep bottle‑green with delicate floral embroidery in muted gold thread and small round metal buttons left mostly open; around his waist is a broad maroon silk patka sash wrapped twice and knotted slightly to the left, its ends hanging down with a restrained gold border and tiny paisley motifs; he wears straight, slightly narrow churidar trousers in soft beige that bunch neatly at the ankles and simple but well‑made brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes; during campaigns, a light steel‑blue padded armour vest is sometimes worn beneath the green coat, suggested by a faint stiffness at the torso but not heavily plated, keeping the overall silhouette elegant and historically plausible.
appearance.signature: A gently curved Mughal talwar with a slightly broad, polished steel blade, a dark steel hilt with a disc pommel and cross‑guard, and a plain brown leather scabbard; it hangs from a dark brown leather belt worn over the maroon sash, and in portraits he often rests one hand lightly on the hilt.

ref_desc: Aurangzeb Alamgir is a lean, late‑aged Mughal emperor with a narrow bearded face, tall off‑white turban, cream‑striped jama, deep bottle‑green embroidered sleeveless coat, maroon sash, beige churidar, brown mojari shoes, and a plain‑hilted curved talwar in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style model sheet of Aurangzeb Alamgir during his Deccan campaigns: a lean, late‑aged Mughal emperor with a narrow, angular wheatish face, sharp nose, and a long, neatly trimmed steel‑grey beard tapering to a point, his expression calm, austere and observant; he wears a tall, slightly conical off‑white muslin turban with a thin gold edging and a single modest emerald‑and‑gold sarpech plume at the front, and visible grey sideburns. His main garment is a calf‑length cream‑white cotton jama cut in cross‑over fashion and tied on the right, with very subtle pale‑gold vertical stripes and thin maroon piping along all edges; over this he wears a hip‑length sleeveless deep bottle‑green velvet coat with delicate muted‑gold floral embroidery and small round metal buttons, worn open so the cream jama shows beneath. Suggest a light steel‑blue padded armour vest under the coat only through slight stiffness at the torso, avoiding bulky plates. Around his waist is a broad maroon silk patka sash wrapped twice and knotted slightly left of center, its ends hanging with a restrained gold border and tiny paisley motifs; over the sash runs a dark brown leather belt suspending his signature gently curved Mughal talwar with a polished steel blade, dark steel hilt with disc pommel, and a plain brown leather scabbard. He wears soft beige churidar trousers that gather neatly at the ankles and brown leather mojari shoes with subtly upturned toes. Show him in neutral, front, side and three‑quarter views with consistent proportions and details, highlighting the cream, deep green, maroon, beige and steel‑blue palette and keeping the overall look dignified, modest and era‑accurate.
